title: Only 14 Large Mammals Were Ever Domesticated
hook: Humans domesticated only 14 candidate large mammals.
closing: The animals that built civilization came from a remarkably short list.
question: Which wild animal would you domesticate?

segments.say: Dogs were domesticated 15,000 years ago. Every familiar farm animal came later.
Only 14 candidate large mammals were domesticated. Most wild species never accepted human control.
The total reached 14 species today. Humanity's large-animal roster has barely changed for millennia.
